name: Feather Token, Anchor
description: A single-use token that moors a watercraft and renders it immobile for up to one day.

name: Feather Token, Bird
description: A single-use token that delivers a small written message unerringly to a designated target, as a carrier pigeon would.

name: Feather Token, Fan
description: A single-use token that becomes a huge fan, propelling one ship at about 25 mph or reducing existing winds for up to 8 hours. It does not function on land.

name: Feather Token, Swan Boat
description: A single-use token that becomes a swanlike boat moving at 60 feet. It carries eight horses and gear or thirty-two Medium creatures and lasts for one day.

name: Feather Token, Tree
description: A single-use token that instantaneously creates a great oak with a 5-foot-diameter trunk, 60-foot height, and 40-foot crown.

name: Feather Token, Whip
description: A single-use token that becomes a self-wielding +1 whip for up to 1 hour. It attacks at +10, deals 1d6+1 damage, and makes a free grapple attack at +15 after a hit.
